easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena and Glaring Fleshraker's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Elena trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker's trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
